title: Design an electronics enclosure
summary: Model a hollow enclosure for an ESP32 board, add four standoffs, make a lid, and export the parts.
author: LearnCad team
goal: an enclosure for an ESP32 board

lessons.title: Model the outer shell
lessons.summary: Sketch the footprint and pad it to the wall height.
lessons.outcome: A solid enclosure block with the right outer size.

steps.text: In the Ask LearnCad bar, type an enclosure for an ESP32 board and press Enter.
Click Create Body + Sketch, then choose the XY plane.
Click Rect in the sketch toolbar.
Click two opposite corners. Right-click to stop the tool, then press Next.
Select the long edge, click Dimension, and set 70 mm.
Click OK in the value dialog.
Select the short edge, click Dimension, and set 45 mm.
Click OK in the value dialog.
Click Done to close the sketch.
Select the profile, click Pad, set the height to 25 mm, then click OK.
Confirm the pad in the LearnCad dialog.

lessons.title: Hollow the enclosure
lessons.summary: Pocket the inside so the board fits with a 2 mm wall.
lessons.outcome: A shell with an even wall and an open top.

steps.text: Select the top face of the block, then press Next.
Click Sketch and choose that top face.
Click Rect and draw an inner rectangle roughly 2 mm from each wall.
Dimension the inner rectangle to 66 mm by 41 mm, then click Done.
Click OK in the value dialog.
Select the inner profile, open the Model menu, and choose Pocket.
Set the depth to 23 mm so a 2 mm floor remains, then click OK.

lessons.title: Add the board standoffs
lessons.summary: Place four mounting bosses on the floor.
lessons.outcome: Four standoffs that match the board holes.

steps.text: Measure the distance between the board mounting holes, then select the floor face.
Click Sketch and choose the floor face.
Click Circle and place one circle at each hole position.
Select each circle, click Radius, and set 3 mm.
Click OK in the value dialog, then click Done.
Select the four circles, click Pad, and set the height to 5 mm.
Confirm the pad in the LearnCad dialog.

lessons.title: Make the lid and export
lessons.summary: Pad a thin lid on the top face, then save both printable parts.
lessons.outcome: A lid and a shell ready to print.

steps.text: Select the top rim of the shell, then press Next.
Click Sketch and choose that face.
Click Rect and draw a rectangle 2 mm larger than the shell on every side.
Dimension the lid to 74 mm by 49 mm, then click Done.
Click OK in the value dialog.
Select the lid profile, click Pad, set 3 mm, then confirm.
Confirm the pad in the LearnCad dialog.
Select the lid, click Export, and save an STL. Repeat for the shell.
Click Export on the main toolbar.
